clusters.headline: Translation elongation cluster in E. coli
clusters.observation: This cluster contains 12497 genes, led by Translation elongation factor Tu (180) and UTP--glucose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase (EC 2.7.7.9) (168). The species breakdown is dominated by Escherichia coli (5604), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 7390 Resistant and 3935 Susceptible. Interpret this as a grounded research observation, not clinical guidance.
